class.name: Box3DWheelJoint
class.brief_description: Box3D's vehicle joint: a sprung, optionally driven and steered wheel.
class.description: Attaches a wheel ([member body_b]) to a chassis ([member body_a]). The wheel rides a suspension spring along [b]this node's local Y axis[/b] (green), spins about [b]its local Z axis[/b] (blue, the axle), and can steer about the suspension axis. One joint per wheel: drive the rear pair with the spin motor, steer the front pair with the steering target. See the demo's Car sample, which mirrors upstream Box3D's Driving sample.

method.name: get_spin_speed
method.description: Current wheel spin in radians per second. Multiply by the wheel radius for road speed, or compare against [member spin_motor_speed] to detect wheelspin.

method.name: get_spin_torque
method.description: Torque the spin motor applied on the last step, in newton-metres -- the wheel's actual delivered drive or braking force.

method.name: get_steering_angle
method.description: Current steering angle in radians, which lags [member target_steering_angle] by however much the steering drive can manage.

method.name: get_steering_torque
method.description: Torque the steering drive applied on the last step, in newton-metres.

members.member: Full lock in one direction, in radians.
Deepest allowed suspension compression, in metres.
Torque budget for the spin motor, in newton-metres: engine power at the wheel, and the brake when [member spin_motor_speed] is 0. At 0 the wheel freewheels.
Torque budget for the steering drive, in newton-metres. At 0 the wheel cannot be steered.
Drives the wheel about its axle -- this is the throttle.
Target wheel spin, in radians per second. Sign picks forward or reverse.
Damping ratio for the steering spring, non-dimensional.
Enables the steering drive about the suspension axis.
Stiffness with which the wheel is pulled to [member target_steering_angle], in cycles per second. Low values give slow, heavy steering.
Clamps the steering angle to [member lower_steering_limit] .. [member upper_steering_limit] -- the vehicle's lock.
Suspension damping ratio, non-dimensional. 1.0 is critical damping; below that the car bounces.
Whether the suspension spring is active. With it off the wheel is rigidly mounted.
Suspension stiffness in cycles per second. Low is soft and floaty, high is stiff and skittish.
Clamps suspension travel to [member lower_suspension_limit] .. [member upper_suspension_limit], which stops the wheel sinking into the body on a hard landing.
Steering angle the wheel is driven toward, in radians.
Full lock in the other direction, in radians.
Highest allowed suspension extension, in metres.
